lines.en: I head over to the maid cafe because there's nothing that distracts me from the pain of simply existing like cute girls who want me to fuck their brains out.
lines.zh: 我去了一趟女仆咖啡厅，因为没有什么比那些想让我把她们脑子操出来的可爱女孩更能让我从单纯活着的痛苦中分神了。

lines.en: Thankfully, there are three of those girls here tonight. But Uta-chan, being the head maid, takes it upon herself to serve me in their place. And I wouldn't have it any other way.
lines.zh: 所幸今晚有三个这样的女孩在这儿。不过 Uta 酱作为首席女仆，主动揽下了替她们服务我的活儿。而我也别无所求。

lines.en: You see, {i}this{/i} is the Uta that makes me the most comfortable. It's the one I've known the longest and, even if it's not entirely authentic, it's always been here.
lines.zh: 你瞧，{i}这个{/i} Uta 才是最让我自在的那个。我认识她的时间最长，而且即便不完全真实，她也一直都在这儿。

lines.en: Things have been going away lately. But Uta-chan isn't going anywhere. And I can rely on her to treat me the same way every time I take my wallet out.
lines.zh: 最近很多东西都在离我而去。可 Uta 酱哪儿都不会去。而每当我掏出钱包，我都可以指望她用同样的方式对待我。

lines.en: Plus, I'm her most loyal customer. She probably relies on my money to pay for her Internet streaming subscriptions. There's no way I can leave her alone.
lines.zh: 再说，我是她最忠实的顾客。她大概指望着我付的钱去续她的网络流媒体订阅。我绝不可能丢下她一个人。

lines.en: I couldn’t possibly do that to Uta-chan.
lines.zh: 我绝不可能对 Uta 酱做出那种事。

lines.en: If I ever made her sad, I would have to kill myself.
lines.zh: 如果我有朝一日让她伤心了，我就只能自杀了。

lines.en: Then all three of these girls would have to fight over who gets to fuck my corpse before it goes cold.
lines.zh: 那样这三个女孩就得为了抢在尸体变凉之前操它而大打出手。

lines.en: And I feel like there's no way Uta would ever win that battle.
lines.zh: 而且我觉得 Uta 绝无可能赢得那场战斗。
